summary: The cli.yaml for vyos_l3_interfaces finds test case files, then runs each with network_cli and the first one with local connection.
questions: How do I run every test case file under both network_cli and local?
How does the cli.yaml test runner find test cases?

answer_card.title: Test runner cli.yaml
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: collect all cli test cases
  find:
    paths: "{{ role_path }}/tests/cli"
    patterns: "{{ testcase }}.yaml"
  register: test_cases
  delegate_to: localhost

- set_fact: test_items="{{ test_cases.files | map(attribute='path') | list }}"

- name: run test cases (connection=network_cli)
  include_tasks: { file: "{{ test_case_to_run }}" }
  vars: { ansible_connection: network_cli }
  with_items: "{{ test_items }}"
  loop_control: { loop_var: test_case_to_run }
```
A second task runs with `ansible_connection: local` and `ansible_become: false` using `with_first_found`.
